title: Happy Farm Rush
shortDescription: Grow grass, gather goods, and keep the farm in one piece.
description: Keep a busy farm running through twenty campaign days. Feed geese, collect produce, run workshops, and send goods to market. Keep an eye out for bears. They were not invited.
coverAlt: Happy Farm Rush gameplay showing a green pasture, animals, workshops, and a delivery truck
controls: Tap empty pasture to grow grass. Tap products to collect them and workshops to start production.
Tap the warehouse to choose a shipment. Tap bears repeatedly to cage them, then collect the cage.
Space or Escape pauses. The in-game handbook explains the production chains and campaign goals.
saveNote: Campaign progress saves locally every five seconds and on pause. Hidden tabs pause the farm; there is no offline farming. Settings offers save export and import.
